response.sql: WITH station_avg AS (SELECT observstation, AVG(bandusagepct) AS avg_bw FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation HAVING AVG(bandusagepct) IS NOT NULL), overall AS (SELECT AVG(bandusagepct) AS overall_avg FROM telescopes) SELECT s.observstation, s.avg_bw AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, s.avg_bw - o.overall_avg AS diff_above_overall FROM station_avg s CROSS JOIN overall o WHERE s.avg_bw > o.overall_avg ORDER BY diff_above_overall DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: The overall average is the mean of bandusagepct over all telescope rows with non-null values (each telescope weighted equally), computed from the telescopes table alone, including telescopes whose station has no matching observatories row.
Stations are taken from telescopes.observstation, so only stations that have at least one telescope appear.
